_notes: Overrides only. Every AI task's default (model qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, reply cap, ladder, static fallback) is Line's one set of per-step profiles, packages/core/ai-profiles.json (steps trace.<task>), shown read-only in Cockpit's Settings under 'AI steps'. Put a task here only to override it: "tasks": { "choose": { "provider": "ollama", "model": "qwen2.5-coder:1.5b" } }. provider: ollama (local Qwen etc.), openai (LM Studio / llama.cpp / vLLM), anthropic (Claude, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Tasks: choose, pick-fields, draft-body, explain, mail, part-chat, generate-sample, draft-story. Whether a task runs is set only by its profile: choose and pick-fields are off until a measured win is recorded there (nothing here can turn them on); the other tasks run when you ask. An example folder can override this with its own ai.json. Turn the AI on per run with --ai or the Options menu.
